_readme: Coordinates for airports that no dataset covers: not in
OurAirports dump) and not tagged with `iata` in OpenStreetMap — either the
code is a local/national one (QXB, ZCA) or the field has since closed (LYM).
scripts/generate-airport-maps.mjs reads this file after the two datasets and
before its Overpass lookup, so a verified coordinate here is what puts these
fields on a map instead of leaving them without one. Each entry names where
the coordinate came from — keep that habit when adding one: looked up by IATA
code in Wikidata (P238 -> P625) or from the airport's Wikipedia article.

IEO.source: Wikidata Q1626023, Aioun el Atrouss Airport
